segmente.text: Have you ever started a Netflix show and suddenly had to finish the whole season?
Even if it wasn't that good? That's not your weakness. It's how your brain is wired.
It's called the Zagarnik effect. Your mind simply hates unfinished stories.
It keeps thinking about them and searches for closure.
Smart marketers know this. They don't tell you everything up front.
They open a loop and let your brain chase the ending.
If you want people to remember your brand, don't close the story too soon.
Start it, leave a gap, and let curiosity do the rest.
